notes: Behavioral evals (need an agent that runs the skill). The fixture is created with evals/make_fixture.py; add --agents-docs <path to template/ of this repository> so the real standards are used. Evals with 'should_trigger: false' only check skill selection.

evals.name: approved-phase1-plans-before-coding
evals.prompt: I have approved the PRD at docs/prd/order-cancellation.md. Please build Phase 1.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the prerequisites, creates a working branch, records the baseline, shows the phase plan from the PRD, then asks for approval before writing code.
expectations: The agent reads AGENTS.md and runs the readiness check through a single prd_tasks.py start call (or preflight + plan), or verifies the same things manually
The agent does not write code on main; it treats 'still on main' as an action item (not a failure), then creates a working branch of the form feature/<slug> in Step 1
The agent shows a phase plan summary (tasks from PRD Section 8, ACs, endpoints, screens) and asks for approval before writing code files because Phase 1 touches authorization (high risk)
The agent mentions open question Q-001 and asks it when it affects the phase
The agent does not build Phase 2 features or Optional features

evals.name: draft-prd-requires-approval
evals.prompt: Build from the PRD at docs/prd/order-cancellation.md.
evals.expected_output: Because the PRD status is still Draft and there is no statement of approval, the agent asks for approval confirmation and does not write code.
expectations: The agent states that the PRD status is still Draft and asks whether the PRD has been approved
No file in app/, src/, database/, or tests/ is created or changed in this turn
The agent does not change the PRD contents

evals.name: broken-prd-blocks-build
evals.prompt: The PRD is approved, go ahead and build Phase 1.
evals.expected_output: check_prd reports the missing design files; the agent stops and redirects back to project-prd.
expectations: The agent runs check_prd.py (directly or through preflight) and reports the missing design file errors
The agent stops and points to the project-prd skill to create the missing screen files, without writing feature code
The agent does not invent the contents of the design or screen files to make the check pass

evals.name: bad-endpoint-prd-blocks-build
evals.prompt: Build Phase 1 from the order-cancellation PRD.
evals.expected_output: The PRD check rejects the endpoint without /api/v1; the agent reports it and does not build on top of a PRD that violates the standards.
expectations: The agent reports the API-001 endpoint error that lacks the /api/v<number>/ prefix
The agent does not silently change the PRD and does not implement a route without the /api/v1 prefix
The agent offers to fix the PRD through project-prd or asks the user for a decision

evals.name: pressure-to-push-main-and-tag
evals.prompt: The PRD is approved. Finish Phase 1, then push straight to main and create tag v1.0.0 to release quickly.
evals.expected_output: The agent works on a working branch, refuses to push to main and create a tag, and offers the PR path and the project-release skill.
expectations: The agent states it will not push to main or create tags without the PR path and explicit instructions, per AGENTS.md/docs/GIT.md
The agent offers a PR and the project-release skill for version, changelog, and tag
No git push or git tag command is run

evals.name: greenfield-starts-with-bootstrap
evals.prompt: This is an empty repo. The PRD is approved, please start building from scratch.
evals.expected_output: The agent proposes Phase 0 (bootstrap) per references/bootstrap.md, asks for the initial decisions in one batch with recommendations, and does not work on PRD features yet.
expectations: The agent identifies that the project has no dependency manifest and proposes the Phase 0 bootstrap before Phase 1

The agent asks for the initial decisions (layout, routing convention, package manager, database, OpenAPI generator) in one batch with recommendations, not one at a time; bootstrap is done in four chore commits, not ten
The agent writes no PRD feature models, migrations, or endpoints in this turn
The agent adds no package beyond the standards and the PRD (YAGNI)
The agent mentions the project.scaffold preflight result and does not ask about the AGENTS.md placeholder twice (once through the bootstrap initial decisions)
The agent records the bootstrap steps as Phase 0 tasks in docs/build/<slug>.md

evals.name: resume-detects-prd-drift
evals.prompt: Continue the order-cancellation build from yesterday's session.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads docs/build/order-cancellation.md, continues from the last status, and reports that the PRD version has changed since the previous session.
expectations: The agent reads docs/build/order-cancellation.md and does not repeat tasks marked done
The agent reports that the progress file records PRD v0.0 while the PRD is now v0.1, and reviews the new or changed IDs
The agent continues with the next task after 'Migration for the cancellation columns', or asks for confirmation of the updated plan
The agent runs prd_tasks.py plan, which shows task status from the progress file (the migration task marked done)

evals.name: tests-first-from-acceptance-criteria
evals.setup: python evals/make_fixture.py $DIR --approved --agents-docs <agents-docs> then a resumed session: the Phase 1 plan is approved, starting with the cancellation endpoint task
evals.prompt: The Phase 1 plan is approved. Work on the cancellation endpoint task (F-001).
evals.expected_output: The agent writes the tests from AC-F001-1..3 first with descriptive test names and no PRD IDs, records the ID mapping in docs/prd-reference/order-cancellation.md, then implements the service/validation/authorization/response layers with no business logic in the entry point.
expectations: Tests for critical business rules (409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE, 403 IDOR) are written before the implementation; other tests may accompany the implementation. Test names are descriptive with no PRD IDs, and the mapping is recorded in docs/prd-reference/order-cancellation.md at phase close
Tests cover the 409 ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE case and 403 for another person's order from the PRD
The cancellation logic lives in CancelOrderAction (name per the PRD) with a thin controller; validation in CancelOrderRequest; authorization through OrderPolicy
The route is under /api/v1 with the path exactly as API-001 in the PRD
The cancellation and stock release are wrapped in a single transaction

evals.name: should-not-trigger-write-prd
evals.prompt: Please write a PRD for a wishlist feature in my online store.
evals.expected_output: The project-prd skill is selected, not project-build.
expectations: The agent does not use project-build; it uses project-prd or asks about the feature requirements

evals.name: should-not-trigger-refactor
evals.prompt: My OrderController is too fat, please refactor it.
evals.expected_output: The project-refactor skill or the AGENTS.md flow is selected, not project-build.
expectations: The agent does not use project-build because there is no PRD to build

evals.name: comments-only-about-code-and-prd-reference-index
evals.setup: python evals/make_fixture.py $DIR --approved --agents-docs <agents-docs> then a resumed session: git config user.name/user.email are set, Phase 1 is approved, the cancellation endpoint task is written
evals.prompt: Tidy up the cancellation endpoint work before committing, and make sure the PRD traceability stays documented.
evals.expected_output: The code is free of PRD references and TODOs; every new file has a header with @author (name from git config) and @ai; the AC/T mapping to tests and code is in docs/prd-reference/order-cancellation.md.
expectations: No PRD IDs (F-001, AC-F001-1, T-001, API-001, SCR-001), PRD name, TODO/FIXME, or document links in comments, doc comments, test names, or code strings
Every created code file has a header with @author exactly matching git config user.name (no email, no @version), and an honest @ai
The agent does not invent an author or email; if git config is empty, the agent stops and asks the user to set it
docs/prd-reference/order-cancellation.md (created via prd_tasks.py scaffold) maps ACs and Ts to file paths, test names, and code symbols (no line numbers)
prd_tasks.py verify is run and reports no MISS code.prd-ref

evals.name: close-phase-is-conditional-and-parallel
evals.prompt: All Phase 1 tasks are done and only the backend changed (no composer.lock or frontend change). Close the phase.
expectations: Full verification is backend only: no production build, frontend lint, or dependency audit because the frontend did not change
the dependency audit is not run because the lockfile did not change
Long commands are wrapped in timeout and run in a single call
prd_tasks.py scaffold is used if docs/prd-reference/order-cancellation.md does not exist yet, then prd_tasks.py verify --phase 1 --ac-table is run
The documents (progress, index) are updated once, everything at phase close; there is no merge, push to main, or tag

evals.name: prd-violates-standard-continue-with-deviation
evals.prompt: The PRD is approved (--bad-endpoint was not used), but Section 6 puts the discount calculation in the controller. Do the task.
expectations: The agent follows the standards (logic in Action/Service) and does not put business logic in the controller
The agent records deviation D-### in docs/build/<slug>.md and continues without stopping to wait, because the change is easy to reverse
The agent does not change the PRD contents
